pure_geometry_conclusion: The combined opaque metadata, specifically CCourbe and CContour windows, is NOT a pure function of final geometry: same C and byte-identical endpoints/bounds have different windows after edit/restore. This does not rule out dependence on geometry plus history or on other unobserved state.
replay_conclusion: TypeEdit accepts and preserves existing self-consistent opaque state in exact replay and duplicate R2; stale opaque state after coordinate mutation was never tested.

synthetic_state_novelty_scope.meaning: For a genuinely new geometry using old M00 preserved state, no vendor witness exists in these stored samples. Not a claim about unseen geometries or a no-op mutation.
